Make only one tiny correction: immediately below the right-panel warm "准备生成" button there is a small empty checkbox next to the text "新结果保留为候选". REMOVE the checkbox entirely and keep that text as ordinary muted non-interactive helper text, aligned with the prompt panel left edge. Do not change any layout or add anything. The helper is a fact and must not appear optional. No other redesign.
